description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction To The Team**
 At Expedia Group, our Cyber Security team builds cloud platforms, services, data pipelines, and automation that help protect our business, customers, partners, and employees. As an SDE II, you will independently deliver end\\-to\\-end capabilities within a service and contribute to broader cloud and AI\\-focused security initiatives.
   

  

 You will apply sound software engineering practices to solve defined technical problems, explain how your work supports security and business outcomes, and use data to test relevant assumptions. You will work with senior engineers on broader architecture and complex initiatives, while owning the quality, observability, operational health, and continuous improvement of the components and services assigned to you.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, resilient, and secure software services and components that support Expedia Group products and platforms.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other engineers to translate business and customer requirements into robust system designs, including low\\-level design, API design, and data models.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well‑documented code, automated tests, and tooling that improve reliability, observability, and operational excellence for your services.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions, identifying opportunities to simplify systems, reduce technical debt, and improve performance and quality across multiple services or domains.
* Own the end‑to‑end lifecycle of features and services, including deployment, monitoring, incident response, and incremental improvement, while safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve outcomes.
* Work across different parts of the stack or adjacent domains as needed, building familiarity with AI\\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 2\\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Hands‑on proficiency in at least one modern programming language and related ecosystem, with experience in system design (LLD), API design, and data modeling for service‑oriented or microservices architectures.
* Experience owning features or services through development, testing, deployment, and operational support, including monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
* Solid understanding of core computer science and engineering fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, distributed systems concepts, and secure coding practices.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing and implementing scalable, fault‑tolerant, and high‑throughput services, including well‑structured APIs and data models that serve multiple teams or domains.
* Demonstrated track record of improving service availability, performance, or reliability through metrics, observability, automation, and strong operational practices.
* Background integrating or leveraging AI/ML‑enabled components or platforms within production systems, and safely operating AI‑driven features to enhance customer and business outcomes.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or layers of the stack (e.g., front‑end, back‑end, data, or platform services), adapting quickly to new technologies, patterns, and AI‑driven tooling.
* Ability to contribute to and influence technical designs within a team or product area, making data‑driven decisions and helping to evolve engineering standards, patterns, and best practices.


**Accommodation requests**
 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\\-now.com/askeg?id\\=job\\_accommodation.

 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \\- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \\- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
Category\\-defining tech. Career\\-defining work.
   

  

 Lots of tech companies disrupt. But, many fail when they try to scale. We're different. CockroachDB makes it easier for companies to build and scale apps. This is how and why we're helping some of the most innovative companies on the planet. We tackle problems head\\-on and focus on solutions that create lasting impact.
   

  

 Because when our customers win, we all win.
   

  

**The Role**
 Cockroach Labs is looking for a software engineer to join Code Systems, part of our Engineering Productivity organization based in India. Code Systems builds and operates roachdev, CRL's unified infrastructure for running coding agents and automating engineering workflows across the company \\- from an engineer's laptop, to worker VMs, to stateless cloud agents triggered by GitHub, Slack, and Mica.
   

  

 This role has shifted from a traditional DevOps/developer\\-infrastructure profile to one centered on general software engineering and applied AI. You'll spend most of your time building and hardening AI\\-powered developer tools \\- building AI automated code review, CI failure triage, and agentic automation \\- rather than just managing build systems or CI infrastructure in isolation. You'll still need working knowledge of CI/CD and developer workflows, but the emphasis is on shipping product\\-quality software that happens to serve engineers as its customers.
   

  

 Success in this role means designing and building reliable, observable systems that put AI agents safely in the loop of everyday engineering work, and collaborating closely with engineering teams across CRL to roll them out.
   

  

 Our team values
   

  

* Providing high\\-quality support to Cockroach Labs engineering teams and a strong desire to help other people work more productively.
* Engaging with other Cockroach Labs engineers to build relationships, listen to developer pain points, and identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to real workflows.
* Minimizing and automating away toil \\- including the toil of using AI safely and reliably.
* Shipping incrementally, measuring quality with real data, and being honest about where AI tooling still needs a human in the loop.


 Some examples of work the team is doing
   

  

* Building roachdev's AI code review pipeline \\- migrating CRL's major repositories (cockroach, pebble, managed\\-service) off third\\-party review tools (BugBot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code Action) onto our own AI\\-driven PR review system.
* Adding observability to AI review: surfacing findings, confidence scores, and token/cost metrics as build artifacts, backed by an event gateway that routes GitHub webhooks through Pub/Sub and a metrics pipeline for quality comparison.
* Building a CI triage agent that automatically investigates failed builds, scores suspect PRs by file overlap, and posts a verdict (e.g. revert recommended, likely flake, likely infra) to Slack \\- cutting the time engineers spend manually bisecting broken builds.
* Extending Blathers (our GitHub/Jira automation bot) to safely auto\\-merge low\\-risk PRs for teams like test\\-eng, gated on code ownership, AI review sign\\-off, and green CI.
* Supporting company\\-wide initiatives such as the transition of CockroachDB's source to private repositories, including tooling to safely duplicate/rebase PRs across repos and guard against leaking sensitive data on public repos.
* Maintaining and evolving the GitHub\\-Jira issue sync system (Exalate) and the CLA\\-checker service, and evaluating what of that surface area can be modernized, simplified, or replaced outright.


 The ideal candidate will have solid, general software engineering fundamentals, genuine curiosity about applying LLMs/AI agents to real engineering problems, and enough familiarity with CI/CD, GitHub automation, and cloud infrastructure to reason about where AI tooling plugs into the developer workflow. You should enjoy moving between problems \\- one week you might be improving an agent's prompt and evals, the next you might be debugging a GitHub webhook pipeline or a Cloud Run service.
   

  

**You Will**
* Design, build, and operate AI\\-powered developer tools on top of roachdev \\- including automated code review, CI failure triage, and agentic PR automation.
* Build the observability and quality\\-measurement systems that let us trust and improve AI agents in production (metrics pipelines, dashboards, review\\-incorporation checks).
* Work directly with GitHub's API/Apps platform, webhooks, and CI systems (GitHub Actions, TeamCity) to safely automate engineering workflows.
* Partner with engineering teams across CRL to roll out new AI tooling, gather feedback, and iterate quickly.
* Maintain and modernize existing Code Systems services (issue sync/Exalate, CLA checker) with an eye toward reducing their operational footprint.
* Provide direct, service\\-minded support to engineers who hit issues with our tools, primarily in Go and Python.
* Contribute to roachdev's shared skill library and provider abstractions used by coding agents across the company.


**The Expectations**
 In the first month, you will become an integrated member of the Code Systems team. You'll spend your first couple of weeks learning how Cockroach Labs' engineering organization works, getting familiar with roachdev's architecture, and understanding the AI code review and CI triage systems already in production. You'll start with small, well\\-scoped tasks before taking on a larger starter project.
   

  

 In your second month, you'll take on a medium\\-sized project \\- for example, extending the AI review pipeline's observability, improving an agent's reliability, or modernizing a piece of the Exalate/CLA surface area \\- partnered with one or more teammates to plan and deliver it.
   

  

 By the end of the third month, you'll be a fully contributing member of Code Systems, having owned and shipped one or more medium\\-sized projects end to end. You'll be able to propose and scope new work, engage with other engineers across CRL to support our tools, and reason about trade\\-offs between AI\\-driven and traditional automation approaches.
   

  

**You Have**
* 5\\+ years of experience as a software engineer, with strong general\\-purpose coding skills (Go and/or Python preferred).
* Genuine interest and hands\\-on experience building with LLMs/AI agents \\- e.g. prompt engineering, evals, tool\\-calling agents, or AI\\-assisted developer tooling.
* Experience with git/GitHub, including the GitHub API, GitHub Actions, and/or building GitHub Apps/bots.
* Working familiarity with CI/CD systems and the developer workflow they support (you don't need deep build\\-systems expertise, but you should be comfortable reasoning about CI pipelines).
* Some exposure to cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS) and services like Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, or containers \\- you'll use these, but this is not a pure infrastructure role.
* Exceptional communication skills with a service mindset (where engineers are our customers) and a desire to collaborate with other engineers.
* A BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
* A track record of designing and building AI\\-powered systems, tools, or infrastructure that others use — not just for your own productivity.
* Experience integrating models and AI capabilities into systems with evaluation, monitoring, and iteration built in.
* Clear judgment about where AI should be deeply integrated and where traditional approaches are more reliable.


**The Team**
*Abhishek Munnolimath \\- Sr. Manager, Engineering*
 You will report directly to Abhishek. Abhishek joined Cockroach Labs in April 2025 as a Senior Engineering Manager leading the Platform org from India. With 16\\+ years of experience across Microsoft, Oracle, and SaaS companies like Freshworks, he brings deep expertise in cloud services, security, and distributed systems. Passionate about people leadership, mentoring, and business impact, he is excited by Cockroach Labs’ potential to disrupt industries like gaming, e\\-commerce, and financial services. Outside work, he enjoys yoga, travel, and time with his two daughters.
   

  

*Ken Liu \\- Sr. Director of Engineering*
 Ken Liu is an experienced engineering leader, having built and scaled engineering teams at several high\\-growth startups in NYC. Over his years at Cockroach Labs, Ken has built our Engineering Productivity, Security Engineering, and Compliance functions from scratch, including sponsoring the company's push into AI\\-native engineering tooling. Previously, he worked in various industries as a software engineer, including Novartis Pharmaceuticals, IEEE, and BMW. In his free time, he spends most of his energy keeping up with his two teenagers but enjoys reliving the 90s by rollerblading on weekends.
   

  

 Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com.
   

  

 Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Medical Insurance
* Flexible Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Mental Wellbeing Benefits
* Internet Reimbursement
* Wellness Allowance
* Food Allowance
* Office Commute Reimbursement
* And more!
